work.title: Untitled (Triptych with Planes)
work.description: Large-scale triptych collage densely layered with warplane silhouettes, target rings, compact discs, and American footballs across three panels. Red, white, and black dominate, with scattered green and orange accents; fabric lettering, vinyl records, and photographic fragments fill the picture plane.
work.composition: Dense triptych panels with layered collage elements
keywords: compact disc vinyl record layered collage
dense panoramic sports and aviation collage
